x: All three statements are correct: Kudankulam is the flagship of nuclear ties, the Chennai-Vladivostok corridor links the two, and Russia's Culture Minister attended WAVES 2025 in Mumbai.

st.3: After the visit India upgraded its Kabul mission to a full embassy without formally recognising the Taliban regime.

x: All three statements are correct: it was the first official visit by a top Taliban leader since 2021, the Taliban could appoint the Consul General in Mumbai, and India upgraded the Kabul mission to an embassy without recognition.

st.3: Morocco lies between the Atlantic and the Mediterranean and is a major phosphate supplier to India.

x: All three statements are correct: the MoU was signed in Rabat with a Defence Wing to open there, it covers drones and counter-drone systems, and Morocco lies between the Atlantic and the Mediterranean.

st.1: IIT Kharagpur, India's first IIT, was set up in 1961.

x: Neither statement is correct. Statement 1 is wrong: IIT Kharagpur was set up in 1951. Statement 2 is wrong: IIT Madras (1959) was set up with West German aid; Soviet aid went to IIT Bombay.

st.2: Elias 2-24 b, confirmed as the youngest known planet, is a Jupiter-mass gas giant.

x: All three statements are correct: Dragonfly to Titan is due in July 2028 with a radioisotope generator, Elias 2-24 b is a young Jupiter-mass gas giant, and a protoplanetary disk is where planets form.

st.2: The ASW SWC 'Machilipatnam', launched by Cochin Shipyard, is named after a port town of Andhra Pradesh.

x: All three statements are correct: Shruti was launched by GRSE, 'Machilipatnam' is named after an Andhra Pradesh port town, and Samarthak is built by L&T.

st.3: During re-entry, the speed falls from about 7.8 km/s mainly because of retro-rocket firing.

x: Only statement 1 is correct: Gaganyaan plans 3 astronauts at about 400 km for up to 3 days. Statement 2 is wrong: Vyommitra is a female humanoid for the uncrewed flight. Statement 3 is wrong: the speed falls mainly through atmospheric drag (aerobraking).

st.1: The SSLV is a three-stage, all-solid launch vehicle with a liquid velocity-trimming module.

x: All three statements are correct: the SSLV has three solid stages plus a liquid trimming module, Chandrayaan-4 will land at MM-4 near Mons Mouton, and the improved SS3 qualified after a 108-second test.

st.3: The Indian Tsunami Early Warning Centre issues alerts within 30 minutes.

x: Only statement 1 is correct: the Wave-Propelled Vertical Profiler was developed by NIOT. Statement 2 is wrong: JellyAIIP was launched by INCOIS Hyderabad. Statement 3 is wrong: tsunami alerts are issued within 10 minutes.

st.2: A dummy crew capsule of about 5 tonnes was dropped from an IAF Mi-17 helicopter.

x: Only statement 3 is correct: IADT-1 validated the parachute deceleration system. Statement 1 is wrong: it was an air-drop test, not an orbital flight. Statement 2 is wrong: the capsule was dropped from an IAF Chinook.

st.2: It is approved for solid tumours but not yet for blood cancers.
st.3: Cytokine Release Syndrome is not among its side effects.

st.3: The 35-by-35 pledge aims to raise electricity's share of global final energy consumption to 35% by 2035 and is legally binding.

x: Only statement 2 is correct: India upheld equity and CBDR-RC and stressed public finance. Statement 1 is wrong: India's opening statement was delivered by MoEFCC Secretary Narendra Bhooshan. Statement 3 is wrong: the pledge is voluntary.

st.1: Ozone causes the loss of about 110 million tonnes of staple crops a year.

x: All three statements are correct: ozone destroys about 110 million tonnes of staple crops a year, agriculture gives about 74% of India's methane, and PMUY, GOBARdhan, SRI, DSR and AWD are India's measures.

st.4: Myiophanes kempi, an assassin bug, was rediscovered after about 100 years in Meghalaya limestone caves.

x: Statements 1 and 3 are correct: Discodoris cebuensis was first recorded at Haji Ali and Stenothoe lowryi at Aryapalli. Statement 2 is wrong: Lutjanus arakan was first recorded at Gopalpur-on-Sea, Odisha. Statement 4 is wrong: Myiophanes kempi was rediscovered in Andaman limestone caves.

st.1: The share of female teachers fell from 45% to 39%.

x: Statements 2 and 3 are correct: Kerala has 182 female per 100 male teachers, and Chhattisgarh and Himachal are at parity. Statement 1 is wrong: the share rose from 39% to 45%. Statement 4 is wrong: nationally there are 82 female per 100 male teachers.

st.1: It is published by Z/Yen Partners (London) and the China Development Institute.

x: All three statements are correct: GFCI-40 is by Z/Yen and the China Development Institute, GIFT City was 37th and Mumbai 49th, and GIFT City was the only Indian centre in the Asia-Pacific Top 15.

st.1: It is the 20th edition of the WEF index and covers 148 economies.

x: Only statement 3 is correct: Australia entered the Top 10 for the first time and Chad was last. Statement 1 is wrong: the 2026 index covers 145 economies. Statement 2 is wrong: Finland was 2nd and Norway 3rd.

st.3: The International Solar Alliance (2015) is headquartered in Gurugram.

x: All three statements are correct: India ratified the Hong Kong Convention and passed the 2019 Act, the National Solar Mission is part of NAPCC, and the ISA is headquartered at Gurugram.

st.1: Richer States such as Gujarat, Maharashtra and Punjab were among those ranked relatively low.

st.1: Dominica was the most affected country.

x: Only statement 2 is correct: Sweden ranked first, followed by Finland and Denmark. Statement 1 is wrong: the index is published by the World Economic Forum with Accenture. Statement 3 is wrong: India ranked 70th after rising two places.

st.3: India has signed the CTBT but not the NPT, and it opposes the TPNW.

x: None of the statements is correct. Statement 1 is wrong: the Political Council is chaired by the PM (the NSA chairs the Executive Council). st.3: Sea-level rise on the Pacific and Indian Ocean sides of Asia is above the global average.

x: All three statements are correct: the report was by the WMO under Celeste Saulo, Asia is warming at twice the global average, and sea-level rise on Asia's Pacific and Indian Ocean sides is above the global average.

st.3: Andhra Pradesh ranked 1st in SDG 7 and 2nd in SDG 14.

x: All three statements are correct: India scored 71, Kerala and Uttarakhand topped with 79 and Bihar was last, and AP was 1st in SDG 7 and 2nd in SDG 14.

st.1: It is given every two years by the International Mathematical Union.

x: Neither statement is correct. Statement 1 is wrong: the Fields Medal is given every four years. Statement 2 is wrong: Hong Wang is the third woman to win it.

st.2: Four of the five Padma Vibhushan awardees are from Kerala.
